root_cause.text: The mana_remove() function lacks NULL checks for gd->gdma_context and gd->driver_data, allowing a second invocation after a failed PM resume (which calls mana_remove() and NULLs these pointers) to dereference a NULL gc->dev, causing a kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an early return with `if (!gc || !ac) return;` before dereferencing `gc->dev`, preventing the NULL pointer dereference. The CVE description explains that mana_probe() calls mana_remove() on failure, setting the pointers to NULL, and later unbind calls mana_remove again without those checks.
